reauth_confirm.title: Connect to porabim.com again
reauth_confirm.description: Daily Energy now runs on porabim.com: your data and your Moj Elektro token are kept there, and Home Assistant only keeps a key. Continue to porabim.com, enter your meter ID (EIMM) and Moj Elektro token, and you come back here. A day log from version 1 is uploaded to porabim.com once, after the first connection.

abort.already_configured: This porabim.com account is already connected.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different porabim.com account. Connect with the meter this entry was set up with, or add a new entry.
abort.missing_configuration: The porabim.com sign-in is not set up. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: porabim.com did not answer in time. Try again later.
abort.no_url_available: No address for porabim.com is available.
abort.oauth_error: porabim.com sent back something that is not a valid key. Try again.
abort.oauth_timeout: porabim.com did not answer in time. Try again later.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: porabim.com refused the connection. Try again.
abort.oauth_failed: Could not get a key from porabim.com. Try again.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: The connection was cancelled on porabim.com.

connect_porabim.title: Connect to porabim.com
connect_porabim.description: Daily Energy now runs on porabim.com, which keeps your data and fetches it from Moj Elektro every morning. Go to Settings › Devices & services › {title} › Reconfigure, and enter your meter ID and Moj Elektro token on porabim.com. Your day log is uploaded there once; until then it stays in Home Assistant.
